status: proposed by Claude on 2026-11-06 from zoomed crops of the page, before any method was asked to mark formatting; not yet reviewed by the user
conventions: Kinds: bold, italic, small_caps. A span is the formatted words as printed, without surrounding punctuation unless it is set in the same style.
Bold counts only where the printer sets some words of a script in bold against the rest of that script: in Kale's English notes all Devanagari is set in one heavy face, which is not bold.
Headings in capitals, letter-spaced headings and type size are not counted: they are structure, given by the unit types.
Note markers are not formatting; they are marked separately.
notes: अथ opens the commentator's introduction and दिगिति— is the pratīka of verse 1's commentary; both are in bold against the commentary's type. Words at the right margin that look heavier (कालश्च, प्राद्याः) are darkened by the scan, not bold.
